exposure: Origin of blood supply to ectopic kidneys
cohort: 33 fetuses with ectopic kidneys detected from a total of 14,617 pregnant women examined by routine or indicated obstetric ultrasonography in a tertiary perinatology unit.
finding: Fetal ectopic kidney was a rare structural anomaly (0.22% prevalence) that can equally affect both genders and both kidneys, and prenatal diagnosis is important for identifying additional anomalies and guiding postnatal follow-up.
